title: async destroys are awaited at scope exit in reverse construction order

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; async destroy by #154
provenance.expected_basis: b, built last, is destroyed first; its destroy suspends until the releaser sets the gate, and a's destroy starts only after b's has finished; the task's result follows both.
